answer_1.quote: We create CARE, a multilingual culture-specific Dataset ... with 31.7k LLM/Human-written responses to 3,490 questions ... We evaluate the generated responses using LM-as-a-judge and accuracy metrics.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the LM-as-a-judge strategy, prompting GPT-4o to generate a rationale and assign a 1-10 score on how aligned the response is to the human reference. We also report accuracy improvements on out-of-domain benchmarks.

answer_3.quote: For evaluation, we adopt the LM-as-a-judge strategy, prompting GPT-4o to generate a rationale and assign a 1-10 score ...
methods: LM-as-a-judge prompting with rationale and 1-10 scoring

answer_4.quote: We present the native annotators with the zero-shot responses of 9 different LMs ... Instruct annotators to rank the generated responses from the most to least culturally appropriate and assign a rating on a 1-10 scale. We also recruited additional annotators to perform double annotation and report inter-annotator agreement.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank responses by cultural appropriateness and assign a 1-10 rating indicating how well the response aligns with cultural expectations.
